title: when a changed file's signature change makes the base overlay fail to build, say so in the Base overlays section instead of offering it as a revert check

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-203302-a88e, project ork, item S586:

when a changed file's signature change makes the base overlay fail to build, say so in the Base overlays section instead of offering it as a revert check

Evidence: overlay-1 and overlay-2 both failed with "not enough arguments in call to engine.LocalReadOnlyAllowlist / CloudUIAllowlist"
